usedFor: Justdial captures local leads, and Brevo stores each one through “Add Or Update Contact” after a “New Leads” event.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in Justdial, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A new enquiry becomes a Brevo contact, and the update path avoids a duplicate if the person is already there.

watchOut: A repeat enquirer overwrites existing details through “Add Or Update Contact”, so decide which fields should win.
